end.summary:
Practised reading and writing numerals 1–9 and zero.
Matched numerals to groups in 8 attempts; 5 were unaided correct.
Used fingers, clapping, and a full hand plus 3 more fingers to count.
Teach-back was not passed.
Aarav said zero means nothing is there and is not a number; this was not corrected later in the lesson.
end.parentNote: Asha practised numeral matching with Aarav using fingers, claps, and groups of objects. Counting aloud and using a full hand plus three fingers supported the matching work. Aarav mixed up the meaning of zero, and this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, show an empty plate and plates with 1–9 items, and practise saying that zero is also a number because it tells how many are there.
